english.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something commonly occurs or is frequently seen.
Use this when “frequent” means commonly encountered or seen rather than repeatedly done.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for something that happens often or is often encountered.

examples.english: This kind of skin problem is usual in summer.
examples.traditional: 呢種皮膚問題喺夏天好常見。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zung2 pei4 fu1 man6 tai4 hai2 haa6 tin1 hou2 soeng4 gin3

examples.english: This is a frequent problem with old computers.
examples.traditional: 呢種小毛病喺舊電腦好常見。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zung2 siu2 mou4 beng6 hai2 gau6 din6 nou5 hou2 soeng4 gin3

examples.english: It is common to see fresh seafood at this market.
examples.traditional: 喺呢個街市，見到新鮮海鮮好常見。
examples.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 gaai1 si5 gin3 dou2 san1 sin1 hoi2 sin1 hou2 soeng4 gin3
